components.name: Primary button
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Dodaj materiały</button>
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .45rem; min-height: 44px; padding: .62rem .9rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; font: 690 .9rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: var(--primary, #a5e7ff); color: var(--canvas, #0b1019); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #cef2ff; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #a5e7ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { color: var(--muted, #a4b1c3); border-color: var(--line, #283140); background: #202a37; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-primary { transition: background-color .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out; } }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary actions within a panel or toolbar.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-outline"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 10a8 8 0 1 0-1 7m1-13v6h-6"/></svg>Odśwież bazę</button>
components.css: .ds-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .45rem; min-height: 44px; padding: .62rem .9rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; font: 690 .9rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border-color: #394659; background: var(--paper, #131923); color: var(--ink, #e3e9f4); } .ds-outline:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--wash, #1b2432); border-color: var(--primary, #a5e7ff); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #a5e7ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-outline:disabled { color: var(--muted, #a4b1c3); border-color: var(--line, #283140); background: #202a37; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-outline { transition: background-color .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out; } }

components.name: Collection filter
components.description: A visible label and native select for filtering collection data.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: grid; gap: .35rem; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted, #a4b1c3); font: 650 .83rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter-field { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: .55rem .75rem; border: 1px solid #394659; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--ink, #e3e9f4); background: var(--paper, #131923); caret-color: var(--primary, #a5e7ff); font: inherit; color-scheme: dark; } .ds-filter-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #a5e7ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Current collection view
components.description: The selected view in the investigation rail.
components.html: <nav class="ds-rail-nav" aria-label="Widoki bazy materiałów"><button aria-current="page" type="button" class="ds-rail"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3h7v7H3zM14 3h7v7h-7zM3 14h7v7H3zM14 14h7v7h-7z"/></svg>Baza materiałów</button><button type="button" class="ds-rail"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 12h4M5 7l5 4m4 0 5-4M5 17l5-4m4 0 5 4M3 3h4v4H3zM17 3h4v4h-4zM3 17h4v4H3zM17 17h4v4h-4zM10 10h4v4h-4z"/></svg>Graf śledczy</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-rail-nav { display: grid; grid-auto-rows: min-content; gap: .25rem; align-content: start; padding: 1.2rem .75rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #283140); } .ds-rail { min-height: 44px; padding: .62rem .9rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; font: 690 .9rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; width: 100%; padding: .55rem .65rem; text-align: left; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #a4b1c3); } .ds-rail svg { flex: none; } .ds-rail:hover { background: var(--wash, #1b2432); color: var(--ink, #e3e9f4); } .ds-rail[aria-current] { background: var(--wash, #1b2432); border-color: #344a62; color: var(--primary, #a5e7ff); } .ds-rail:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #a5e7ff); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-rail-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #283140); padding: .4rem .75rem; } .ds-rail { width: auto; flex: none; } } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-rail-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-rail { width: 100%; padding-inline: .5rem; font-size: .84rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-rail { transition: background-color .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out; } }

components.name: Accepted relationship
components.description: Compact status label for an accepted pair.
components.css: .ds-accepted { display: inline-block; border-radius: 4px; padding: .15rem .35rem; background: #173238; color: #79e2d6; font: 650 .8rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Collection group card
components.description: A group heading and its measured collection metrics.
components.css: .ds-campaign { min-width: 0; padding: 1.1rem; background: var(--paper, #131923); border: 1px solid var(--line, #283140); border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); color: var(--ink, #e3e9f4); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-campaign h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.14; } .ds-campaign dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 6rem), 1fr)); gap: .65rem; margin-block: .9rem; padding: .7rem; background: var(--canvas, #0b1019); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-campaign dt { color: var(--muted, #a4b1c3); font-size: .75rem; } .ds-campaign dd { margin: .25rem 0 0; font: 600 .93rem var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace); }

components.name: Saved pair score
components.description: Prominent score in the evidence inspector.
components.css: .ds-score { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: .6rem; margin-top: .75rem; padding: .65rem .8rem; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel-raised, #19212e); color: var(--ink, #e3e9f4); font: .9rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-score strong { color: var(--accent, #52dacd); font: 650 1.6rem var(--mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Methadata is a Polish-language investigation workspace for comparing saved pages and ads. Analysts need to see which pairs met the grouping criteria, trace the result to source material, and recognize when the available input cannot support a conclusion.

The collection uses a dark navy shell and a navigation rail. Place counts, relationships, captures, and provenance where analysts need them to follow a result from the collection to the source. The supplied Stitch series covers the [explorer](docs/stitch/explorer.png), [graph](docs/stitch/graph.png), [evidence inspector](docs/stitch/evidence.png), and [timeline and simulator](docs/stitch/timeline.png). The HTML companions sit beside the PNGs. The running interface uses saved collection data and the tokens in [the frontend stylesheet](frontend/src/styles.css).
